newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT buys Britain's Simmons Magee.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT buys Britain's Simmons Magee.

text.p: Dutch paper and office products group NV Koninklijke KNP BT said on Monday it had agreed to buy Simmons Magee Plc in Britain.
Simmons Magee is a Basingstoke-based distributor of personal computers and software with annual turnover of more than 60 million stg.

KNP BT said Simmons Magee employed 180 people and showed good profitability but disclosed no further results details. The unit has outlets in Basingstoke, Richmond, Huddersfield, Petersborough, Bristol and Glasgow.

Simmons Magee will become part of KNP BT's subsidiary Info'Products Europe. The acquisition has made Info'Products UK one of the largest players in the British personal computers market, KNP BT said in a statement.
